description: Issue #37: Staleness detection and display; Issue #38: Reconcile station totals; Issue #39: Remove dead controls; Issue #40: Fix sparkline scaling. All four issues addressed in one feature.
steps: 1. In src/utils/timeUtils.ts: Export a named constant `STALENESS_THRESHOLD_MS = 2_700_000` (45 min). Add and export `isStale(updatedAt: string | number | undefined): boolean` that returns true if updatedAt is undefined, or if `Date.now() - new Date(updatedAt).getTime() > STALENESS_THRESHOLD_MS`.

2. In src/components/StationCard.tsx: Import `isStale` from timeUtils. Compute `const stale = isStale(station.current_levels?.updated_at)`. If stale, pass alert_level -1 to AlertLevelBadge (override). Add `text-destructive` styling to the timestamp span when stale. Pass `normalLevel={station.normal_water_level}` and `dangerLevel={station.danger_water_level}` to MicroTrendChart.

3. In src/routes/stations/$id.tsx: Import `isStale` from timeUtils. Compute staleness. If stale, override AlertLevelBadge to -1 and show a warning message 'Data may be delayed' with the absolute timestamp. For prev/next navigation: import `useFilter` from FilterContext, apply the `showOfflineStations` filter to stationsData so the 'Station X of Y' count and navigation match the list page. Replace the raw `stationsData` with a `filteredStationsData` that applies at minimum the offline filter (and ideally the full filter set to match what the list page shows).
4. In src/lib/FilterContext.tsx: Export the `DEFAULT_FILTERS` constant (already exported). No additional context changes needed since the detail page can import useFilter and apply filters locally.

5. In src/components/AdvancedFilter.tsx: Fix alertLevelStats to count only stations that pass the showOfflineStations filter (filter stations by `station.station_status` when `!filters.showOfflineStations` before computing stats). Remove the 'Apply Filters' and 'Cancel' buttons from the sticky footer. Keep only 'Reset' button and informational result count text. Remove the `onFilterChange` prop from the interface and all usages of it inside the component. Remove the `applyFilters` function.
6. In src/routes/stations/index.tsx: Remove the `onFilterChange={() => {}}` prop passed to AdvancedFilter. Just pass `stations={stationsData}` and `className`.

7. In src/components/BottomNavigation.tsx: Remove `isVisible` state, `lastScrollY` state, the `useEffect` with `controlNavbar`, and the `useState` import if no longer needed (keep if other states exist). Remove the `translate-y-full` conditional from className. The nav should always show `translate-y-0` (or just remove the translate classes entirely). Keep everything else (tabs, buttons, etc).

8. In src/components/MicroTrendChart.tsx: Add `normalLevel?: number` and `dangerLevel?: number` to the props interface. In the chartPath useMemo: if both normalLevel and dangerLevel are provided and not both 0, use them as the y-axis range (min=normalLevel, max=dangerLevel). Data points outside this range should be clamped (clamp y between 0 and viewBox height). If normalLevel and dangerLevel are both 0 or not provided, fall back to current local min/max behavior.
9. In convex/stations.ts: In the `getStationDetailById` handler, delete the comment `// Only 4 queries total instead of fetching ALL 40 stations!` (the stale '40 stations' comment).

10. Update tests: In src/components/__tests__/StationCard.test.tsx, ensure the mock for MicroTrendChart still works (it's already mocked out). Add a test that verifies staleness behavior (mock Date.now, set updated_at to >45 min ago, verify AlertLevelBadge receives -1). Optionally add a unit test for isStale in a new test file src/utils/__tests__/timeUtils.test.ts.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` passes with no errors
`npm run test` passes (58+ tests, including new staleness tests)
`npm run lint` does not introduce new warnings beyond the existing 76
isStale utility correctly returns true for timestamps >45 min old and undefined
StationCard shows grey badge (alert_level -1) and red timestamp for stale stations
Detail page shows staleness warning and grey badge for stale stations
Detail page prev/next navigation uses filtered station list matching the list page
AdvancedFilter alertLevelStats counts only stations passing the offline filter
AdvancedFilter has no Apply/Cancel buttons, only Reset and informational count
AdvancedFilter component no longer accepts onFilterChange prop
BottomNavigation has no scroll listener or hide-on-scroll behavior
MicroTrendChart uses normalLevel/dangerLevel for y-axis scaling when available
MicroTrendChart falls back to local min/max when thresholds are both 0
The stale '40 stations' comment is removed from convex/stations.ts
verification: npm run lint 2>&1 | grep -c 'problems' to confirm still 76 or fewer total
findings: Build passes, 64 tests pass (6 new timeUtils tests added), lint stays at exactly 76 pre-existing problems. All changes are frontend/display logic except the one stale comment deletion in convex/stations.ts.
